title: Earliest known chariots
summary: The oldest known chariots, light two-wheeled horse vehicles with spoked wheels, come from Sintashta culture burials on the Eurasian steppe. Some specialists class these finds as carts, not true chariots.
why: Light spoked wheels made fast horse-drawn vehicles possible.

notes.problem: Disputed 'oldest' claim marked established; source: 'Littauer and Crouwel (1996) and Raulwing and Burmeister (2012) disagree that the Sintashta culture vehicle finds are true chariots, but rather classed as carts.'
